spec.direction: sign of announced target midpoint change; single targets have equal bounds
spec.hold: only a subsequent scheduled meeting with identical target bounds establishes a hold state
spec.initial: unknown until first directional change; no pre-1994 direction seed
spec.unknown_time: date-only announcements conservatively available at next calendar-day midnight ET
spec.cycle: first hike after easing begins a cycle; ends immediately before next such hike
spec.sessions: existing usable daily 10Y CMT observation calendar, as in the inflation study
spec.return_model: research.targets.par_bond_return; daily rebought par bonds; calendar days/365
spec.financing: existing 91-day discount-bill investment-yield convention; start-interval rate
spec.excess: duration total return minus compounded bills return over the same execution window
spec.costs: 5bp times absolute duration-weight change, including initial entry; no bills-leg fee; no forced final exit
spec.strategy_grid: daily close state, execute next session close; weight applies after execution close
spec.reserved_note: reserved whole cycles, not pristine out-of-sample: prior exposure to their outcomes

inference.unit: equal-weight complete cycle means; resample cycles, not overlapping months
inference.output: descriptive 95% cycle-bootstrap intervals only; no p-values

inflation_comparison.unknown: excluded, not assigned to the comparison group
inflation_comparison.note: one mutually exclusive comparison; inflation and ZLB never alter allocation
